bio: Kansai’s Kamigata-style tempura lives on here. The selection centres on white-fleshed fish from Osaka Bay and the Seto Inland Sea, along with vegetables from across the Kansai region. Fried in lightly scented cottonseed oil, the tempura is cloaked in a pale batter, with salt bringing out the ingredients. The meal finishes with the restaurant’s original salt-seasoned tendon, inspired by tenbara, rice topped with bite-sized tempura. Its salt-seasoned kakiage combines shrimp with seasonal vegetables, bringing a sense of the season to the dish.
